DIAGNOSIS READY: Childhood Temporal Lobe Epilepsy.

The EEG results showing interictal spikes and sharp waves localized to the right temporal lobe, combined with your history of unresponsiveness, facial grimacing, and post-ictal confusion, are diagnostic of focal epilepsy originating in the temporal lobe. Given your age and lack of prior history, this suggests an onset of epilepsy during the developmental years.
